ACCESS: robots.txt WAS retrievable this session (https://www.macys.com/robots.txt, HTTP 200, 2,261 bytes, curl_cffi via lib/probe.py) - unlike the Furniture pass, which recorded it as permanently 403. It contains a NAMED Claude group: 'User-agent: ClaudeBot' followed by 'Crawl-delay: 5' and NO Disallow line. A named group with no Disallow is not an exclusion, so this is not a robots HARD STOP; the most-specific-group rule means the generic 'User-agent: *' disallow list does not bind ClaudeBot, but I honoured the Crawl-delay by raising probe.MIN_GAP to 6.0s per host for the whole company and I additionally stayed off every path the '*' group disallows (/search*, /shop/all/*, */Sortby/*, *Productsperpage, /shop/*,*,*,*,*?* facet URLs) because those are View-All/search/facet URLs I am barred from recording anyway. All category pages fetched 200 first try on rotating curl_cffi profiles (edge101, safari17_2_ios, chrome124); no proxy, no r.jina.ai needed. Every fetched page is cached to disk so no URL was requested twice.

TREE: Macy's mega-menu is server-rendered into the Home landing page (/shop/home?id=22672 -> normalises to the Home department id=173142) as <a data-text=... href=...> nodes, and every category page additionally carries its own left-rail child list. I walked top-down recursively, treating as a child only a link whose path is exactly the current path plus ONE additional all-lowercase slug segment - Macy's facet URLs are distinguishable because their added segment is Capitalised (/Brand/, /Price/, /Pageindex/), so this cleanly separates real categories from facets. Bath entry point: Home > Bedding and Bath (/shop/home/bed-bath?id=7495, 11,067) whose only two children are Bedding (20919) and Bath (60241). Bath (2,364) has exactly 5 children: Bath Accessories (22094), Bath Robes (51483), Bathroom Rugs & Bath Mats (8240), Shower Accessories (8237) and Towels (16853). Shower Accessories has 5 children and Towels has 8; Bath Accessories, Bath Robes and Bathroom Rugs & Bath Mats have none (their pages carry no deeper /bed-bath/bath/... category link at all, only facets), so they are true leaves. Depth 4 was probed and does not exist. 19 nodes in the Bath subtree in total. The Bath parent URL is NOT recorded (rule 24) because valid children exist; Shower Accessories and Towels are likewise emitted as grouping rows only.

MIRRORS: Macy's has no bathroom-fixtures department (it is a department store - no toilets, basins, baths, taps, enclosures or bathroom vanity units anywhere in the catalogue), but it does carry bathroom mirrors, filed under Home Decor > Mirrors (/shop/home/home-decor/mirrors?id=190359, h1 'Wall Mirrors', 991) with 5 children. Per rules 2, 10 and 11 (PRIMARY PRODUCT TYPE outranks WEBSITE HIERARCHY, and 'Vanity'/'Bathroom' must never cause exclusion) I inspected the rendered tiles of each. Vanity Mirrors (341877, 335) and Magnifying & Makeup Mirror (341858, 26) are dominated by bathroom mirrors - rendered product titles include '32x24 Inch Bathroom Mirror with LED Lights Dimmable Makeup Vanity Mirror', 'LED Bathroom Vanity Mirror with Lights, Anti-Fog Dimmable Wall Mounted', '23.6x31.5 In Led Backlit Light Bathroom Wall Mounted Vanity Mirror 3X Magnifier', 'Keonjinn Vanity Wall Mirror Bathroom Mirror', 'Apmir ... Bathroom Vanity Mirror' - so both are recorded as Bathroom. Their three siblings (Wall Mirrors 502, Round Mirrors 88, Large Mirrors 94) are the general decorative-mirror range and are routed to Decor in `review`, not silently dropped.

QTY: exact and double-sourced on every recorded node. Primary source is the server-rendered Nuxt payload in <script type="application/json" data-nuxt-data="nuxt-app">, which is devalue-flattened (values are integer pointers into one big array), so a literal regex on the HTML returns nothing - I wrote a slot resolver (scratchpad/macys_lib.py) and read pageDataStore -> productCount. Second, independent source in the SAME document: the server-rendered Tealium block, utag_data['total_results'] = 'N'. The two agreed EXACTLY on all 24 nodes read (Bath 2364/2364, Bath Accessories 1265/1265, Shower Accessories 282/282, Shower Caddies 33/33, Shower Curtain Hooks & Rings 49/49, Shower Curtain Rods 12/12, Shower Curtain Liners 6/6, Shower Curtains 214/214, Towels 583/583, Vanity Mirrors 335/335, Magnifying & Makeup 26/26, Wall Mirrors 502/502, ...).
